limitations: Five selected fault-injection cases, three repeated rounds per condition; not independent samples or organic production incidents.
Production names a benchmark model profile, not production authority, readiness certification or a general efficacy claim.
Raw and exposed-feature cohorts differ. Protocol and source states also differ across the four categories.
Candidate service and mechanism scores do not establish causal correctness; human review remains pending.
All 15 skilled findings remain not-established with unassessed finding-service scores, not scored finding-service misses.
Original-source retrieval and the causal or privacy impact of artifact redaction remain unassessed.
The host exposes a model identifier, not an immutable backend build; hashes are not a complete public replay archive.

pairing.interpretation: Three repetitions of five paired cases, not independent samples or a causal-effect estimate.

publication.policy: metadata-only allowlist; no raw telemetry, narratives, captures, local paths, session IDs or reveal links
publication.scorePolicy: Native scores preserved without label normalization or regrading.

run.budgetScope: shared across all rounds and both conditions; monitored cutoff, not a hard billing cap
run.executionSurface: installed Copilot headless runtime with host-mediated evidence
